A useful experiment would be to vary the initial concentration of the catalyst while keeping the substrate concentration constant. This can help us observe how the reaction rate changes with catalyst concentration, which can highlight differences in the mechanisms involving ligand effects or dimerization.

For instance, if the reaction rate shows a non-linear increase with catalyst concentration, it might suggest dimerization or ligand effects. If the rate increases linearly, it might suggest a simple catalytic cycle without significant dimerization or ligand effects.

Therefore, I propose an experiment with a lower initial concentration of catalyst to observe the initial rate dependence on catalyst concentration.
